params.name: reconciliation_status
params.description:
The reconciliation status of the transaction designated by accounts payable

* `reviewed` - Reviewed
* `pending` - Pending

items.docs:
Returns a list of all closed (fully captured, not just authorizations)
transactions across all issued cards on the platform, regardless of the
cards current status.

params.name: bill_groups

params.description: Filter payments created on or after this date.

params.name: created_at_before
params.description: Filter payments created on or before this date.

params.name: ids
params.description: Filter payments by a comma-separated list of payment IDs.

params.name: invoice_number
params.description: Filter payments by exact bill invoice number.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Order results by field. Prefix with '-' for descending order.

params.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: payment_amount
params.description: Filter payments with an amount equal to this value.

params.name: processing_date_after
params.description: Filter payments with a processing date on or after this date.

params.name: processing_date_before
params.description: Filter payments with a processing date on or before this date.

params.name: status
params.description:
Filter payments by status. Accepts a comma-separated list of statuses.

* `draft` - draft
* `pending_approval` - pending_approval
* `approved` - approved
* `denied` - denied
* `paid` - paid
* `processing` - processing
* `failed` - failed
* `scheduled` - scheduled

params.name: updated_at_after
params.description: Filter payments updated on or after this date.

params.name: updated_at_before
params.description: Filter payments updated on or before this date.
